text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu brilliantly secures the 
double crown. The crowd goes wild over her 
overwhelming power, looking forward to the 
history-making first Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the summer in between, the final 
crown, the Shuka Sho, is next. The two 
make thorough preparations to secure a 
decisive victory. Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A craving had begun to stir within the 
Trainer. A desire to keep watching Mejiro 
Ramonu run... even beyond conquering the 
Triple Tiara.
